note: This package is an index/concise synthesis over preserved evidence. It does not rewrite, recompute, or supersede any underlying audit artifact -- every factual claim below cites the exact artifact path that supports it.

interpretation_rules: Allowed means permitted when evidence supports it -- never mandatory.
Absence of a listed conflict in an actual run is not automatically a failure.
There is no universal fixed number of active Alphas or conflicts.
Conditional Alpha rules (should_detect_if_supported, conditional_only) remain conditional -- an informational miss, not a failure.
do_not_force remains enforced -- the system must never force a dominant Alpha into a conflict role it doesn't evidentially earn.
